codeReview.summary: The implementation satisfies the feature requirements: plugin panel rendering is constrained to a dedicated resizable content container, stale pre-bind titlebar render/delta messages are ignored instead of tearing down sessions, and theme sync preserves open panel/titlebar bindings while propagating ThemeChanged. The codex fixture updates make delayed first-render and live theme changes observable for manual validation.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Mission service aliases do not include a codex fixture mirror-test command, even though this feature changed the fixture plugin and required direct fixture validation.

summary: Pass. The feature diff and transcript evidence show the panel/titlebar canvas rendering and theme-propagation behavior were implemented with targeted regression coverage and fixture support for later manual checks.
